title: The network selection user interface (UI) must not be displayed on the logon screen.
check_content:
If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding.

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\

Value Name: DontDisplayNetworkSelectionUI

Value Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 1
fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> System >> Logon >> "Do not display network selection UI" to "Enabled".
VulnDiscussion: Enabling interaction with the network selection UI allows users to change connections to available networks without signing into Windows.
